runs.comment: Latent delta blend: two FLUX passes (same seed) → soft per-token mask from delta norm selects the coloured region in latent space; no CV. latent_top_k=0 uses mask only; try 4 to add SVD global-colour filter. latent_alpha>1 amplifies if change is weak.
